mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% does not lead to tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST drop does not correlate with broader economic demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with strengthening supply-side fundamentals.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with strong labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) grow by less than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals weak demand and labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of weak RSAFS growth and high UNRATE does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 1%, or low FEDFUNDS does not correlate with positive returns.
